<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the unknown molecule. The only way to infer this without a structure is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically 120‑140 ppm). By counting those signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count. We'll request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
